transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
transcript.content: said: "Hi, I’m Lily Greenberg — we met briefly at that charity event. Nice to see you here. Out of curiosity, where did you go to school or where do you work? I always like to see if we have any mutual connections."

transcript.speaker: Isabella White
transcript.content: Hi Lily — great to see you again. I’m Isabella White. I studied at Auburn University–Montgomery and run a small veterinary clinic downtown. Where did you go to school or where do you work? Do you happen to know anyone from AUM or anyone who’s worked at BellSouth, Coe College alumni circles, or firms like Franklin Templeton? I’m trying to see if we’ve got any overlap.

transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
transcript.content: said: "I’m a partner at a downtown law firm. Funny you ask — I do know at least one person who went to Auburn University–Montgomery and a couple who’ve worked at BellSouth, so there could be overlap. If you tell me a bit about the person you’re thinking of — their profession or the city they live in — I can see if we share a connection."

transcript.speaker: Isabella White
transcript.content: Actually, the AUM alum I had in mind works in the sports/outdoor eyewear industry — at a company that makes performance sunglasses — and is based in the Southeast. She’s also the sort who volunteers with animal rescues on the side. Does that sound like anyone you know?

transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
transcript.content: That profile could match someone I know, but I don’t want to jump to conclusions. Could you share the company name or the city she’s based in, or even the rescue group she volunteers with (or a last-name initial or graduation year)? That would help me see if we’re thinking of the same person.

transcript.speaker: Isabella White
transcript.content: Okay — that helps narrow it down. The person I had in mind works for Oakley (the performance/outdoor eyewear company), is based around the Montgomery/Birmingham area in the Southeast, and volunteers with the Montgomery Humane Society. Her last name starts with a B. Does that match anyone you know?

transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
transcript.content: Thanks — that really narrows it. I do know one AUM alum, but he’s a man who works at Vectren, so that doesn’t fit the Oakley/Montgomery Humane Society profile you described. I also know a couple who've worked at BellSouth, but none match the Oakley + Montgomery area + last initial B combination. If you want, I can check my contacts later or we can compare a first name or graduation year to be certain.

transcript.speaker: Isabella White
transcript.content: Her first name is Blanche. Does that ring a bell? If not, feel free to check your contacts later—I can text you her full name or we can compare graduation years when you have a moment.

transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
transcript.content: Blanche doesn’t ring a bell for me. Could you text me her full name (and, if you know it, her graduation year)? I’ll check my contacts tonight and let you know.

transcript.speaker: Isabella White
transcript.content: Absolutely — I’ll text you her full name right now: Blanche Bishop. I don’t have her exact graduation year memorized, but I’ll include it in the text if I can confirm it. Talk soon!

transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
transcript.content: Thanks, Isabella — I appreciate it. Once I get your text I’ll check my contacts tonight and message you if Blanche turns up. Lovely to reconnect; I’ll be in touch.

transcript.speaker: Isabella White
transcript.content: Wonderful — thank you, Lily. No rush at all. I’ll text you Blanche’s graduation year if I can confirm it. It’s been lovely reconnecting; enjoy the rest of the evening and I’ll be in touch.
